status_definitions.NOT_IMPLEMENTED_AS_PRODUCTION_HTTP_ROUTE: No production HTTP route is currently claimed. Local prototype functions or simulators do not count as this route being implemented.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_BEHIND_SIMULATOR: Route is served but delegates only to a labelled simulator; not production-connected.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_SANDBOX: Route is connected to a provider/institution sandbox and has recorded contract evidence.
status_definitions.PRODUCTION_ACCEPTED: Route has deployment-specific security, integration, operational and domain acceptance evidence.

getHealth.route_specific_requirement: Return liveness only; no dependency or secret detail.
getHealth.acceptance_gate: Probe behaviour is correct; readiness checks dependencies without exposing secrets; capabilities report only actually enabled features.

getReadiness.route_specific_requirement: Check mandatory dependencies; distinguish alive from ready.
getReadiness.acceptance_gate: Probe behaviour is correct; readiness checks dependencies without exposing secrets; capabilities report only actually enabled features.

getCapabilities.route_specific_requirement: Advertise only routes and adapters actually enabled in this deployment.
getCapabilities.acceptance_gate: Probe behaviour is correct; readiness checks dependencies without exposing secrets; capabilities report only actually enabled features.

checkAuthority.dependencies: Credential issuer, trust roots, policy store, revocation source, key management
checkAuthority.route_specific_requirement: Check identity and authority for exact action, resource, purpose and current policy.
checkAuthority.acceptance_gate: Authentication and action/purpose-scoped authorization, expiry/revocation races, rotation and fail-closed behaviour pass tests.

getCredentialStatus.dependencies: Credential issuer, trust roots, policy store, revocation source, key management
getCredentialStatus.route_specific_requirement: Return credential state with source and freshness; unknown is not valid.
getCredentialStatus.acceptance_gate: Authentication and action/purpose-scoped authorization, expiry/revocation races, rotation and fail-closed behaviour pass tests.

createCase.dependencies: Case state store, authority engine, rule version registry, institution adapters
createCase.route_specific_requirement: Authorise submission and persist a versioned case envelope.
createCase.acceptance_gate: Institution-owned decision, prerequisite ordering, idempotency, correction history and authority changes are tested.

getCase.dependencies: Case state store, authority engine, rule version registry, institution adapters
getCase.route_specific_requirement: Enforce case-level access and return state/version plus unresolved status.
getCase.acceptance_gate: Institution-owned decision, prerequisite ordering, idempotency, correction history and authority changes are tested.

recordInstitutionDecision.dependencies: Case state store, authority engine, rule version registry, institution adapters
recordInstitutionDecision.route_specific_requirement: Only the owning institution may decide its stage; check expected state/rule version.
recordInstitutionDecision.acceptance_gate: Institution-owned decision, prerequisite ordering, idempotency, correction history and authority changes are tested.

proposeCorrection.dependencies: Case state store, authority engine, rule version registry, institution adapters
proposeCorrection.route_specific_requirement: Create linked correction request; never erase prior decision/history.
proposeCorrection.acceptance_gate: Institution-owned decision, prerequisite ordering, idempotency, correction history and authority changes are tested.

evaluateMinah.dependencies: Governed model gateway, jurisdiction profile, approved source corpus, evaluation set, human escalation
evaluateMinah.route_specific_requirement: Return disposition only; no automatic approval, authority grant or state commit.
evaluateMinah.acceptance_gate: Traceable source citations and versions, uncertainty/conflict handling, prompt-injection resistance, model outage handling and no direct state commitment are demonstrated.

getMinahDisposition.dependencies: Governed model gateway, jurisdiction profile, approved source corpus, evaluation set, human escalation
getMinahDisposition.route_specific_requirement: Return immutable prior disposition with model and source versions.
getMinahDisposition.acceptance_gate: Traceable source citations and versions, uncertainty/conflict handling, prompt-injection resistance, model outage handling and no direct state commitment are demonstrated.

registerEvidence.dependencies: Evidence store, source registry, versioned rule-pack registry and approval workflow
registerEvidence.route_specific_requirement: Record provenance and metadata; avoid unnecessary raw sensitive data in event envelopes.
registerEvidence.acceptance_gate: Provenance, freshness, access purpose, effective dates, immutability and authorised activation are tested.

getEvidence.dependencies: Evidence store, source registry, versioned rule-pack registry and approval workflow
getEvidence.route_specific_requirement: Enforce purpose-bound access and evidence classification.
getEvidence.acceptance_gate: Provenance, freshness, access purpose, effective dates, immutability and authorised activation are tested.

createRulePack.dependencies: Evidence store, source registry, versioned rule-pack registry and approval workflow
createRulePack.route_specific_requirement: Create draft only; activation is a separate authorised operation.
createRulePack.acceptance_gate: Provenance, freshness, access purpose, effective dates, immutability and authorised activation are tested.

getRulePack.dependencies: Evidence store, source registry, versioned rule-pack registry and approval workflow
getRulePack.route_specific_requirement: Return immutable version metadata and source references.
getRulePack.acceptance_gate: Provenance, freshness, access purpose, effective dates, immutability and authorised activation are tested.

activateRulePack.dependencies: Evidence store, source registry, versioned rule-pack registry and approval workflow
activateRulePack.route_specific_requirement: Require independent approval, effective-date checks and an explicit activation record.
activateRulePack.acceptance_gate: Provenance, freshness, access purpose, effective dates, immutability and authorised activation are tested.

createObligation.dependencies: Approved obligation source, provider sandbox, authenticated callbacks, settlement/reconciliation source
createObligation.route_specific_requirement: Use approved assessment and exact amount/currency; block unapproved or synthetic rules in production.
createObligation.acceptance_gate: Instruction idempotency, provider signature verification, amount/currency binding, late/duplicate callbacks, refunds/reversals and reconciliation pass provider-backed tests.

getObligation.dependencies: Approved obligation source, provider sandbox, authenticated callbacks, settlement/reconciliation source
getObligation.route_specific_requirement: Return amount, currency, source assessment and lifecycle status.
getObligation.acceptance_gate: Instruction idempotency, provider signature verification, amount/currency binding, late/duplicate callbacks, refunds/reversals and reconciliation pass provider-backed tests.

createPaymentInstruction.dependencies: Approved obligation source, provider sandbox, authenticated callbacks, settlement/reconciliation source
createPaymentInstruction.route_specific_requirement: Persist stable idempotency before provider dispatch; instruction is not settlement.
createPaymentInstruction.acceptance_gate: Instruction idempotency, provider signature verification, amount/currency binding, late/duplicate callbacks, refunds/reversals and reconciliation pass provider-backed tests.

getPayment.dependencies: Approved obligation source, provider sandbox, authenticated callbacks, settlement/reconciliation source
getPayment.route_specific_requirement: Return durable state and distinguish accepted, settled and unknown.
getPayment.acceptance_gate: Instruction idempotency, provider signature verification, amount/currency binding, late/duplicate callbacks, refunds/reversals and reconciliation pass provider-backed tests.

recordProviderEvent.dependencies: Approved obligation source, provider sandbox, authenticated callbacks, settlement/reconciliation source
recordProviderEvent.route_specific_requirement: Verify provider authenticity before accepting evidence; bind event to payment, amount and currency.
recordProviderEvent.acceptance_gate: Instruction idempotency, provider signature verification, amount/currency binding, late/duplicate callbacks, refunds/reversals and reconciliation pass provider-backed tests.

reconcilePayment.dependencies: Approved obligation source, provider sandbox, authenticated callbacks, settlement/reconciliation source
reconcilePayment.route_specific_requirement: Require authoritative source sequence and reject stale/repeated conflicting findings.
reconcilePayment.acceptance_gate: Instruction idempotency, provider signature verification, amount/currency binding, late/duplicate callbacks, refunds/reversals and reconciliation pass provider-backed tests.

enqueueEdgeOperation.owner_team: Distributed systems / edge runtime / hardware interface

enqueueEdgeOperation.route_specific_requirement: Apply offline class and expiry; persist operation before acknowledging queue acceptance.
enqueueEdgeOperation.acceptance_gate: Offline policy, expiry, stale authority/rule checks, replay prevention, partitions, restart and rejoin are tested.

synchronizeEdgeNode.route_specific_requirement: Revalidate authority, evidence/rule versions and replay state; queue replay is not approval.
synchronizeEdgeNode.acceptance_gate: Offline policy, expiry, stale authority/rule checks, replay prevention, partitions, restart and rejoin are tested.

getEdgeNodeHealth.owner_team: Distributed systems / edge runtime / hardware interface
getEdgeNodeHealth.dependencies: Durable local queue, node identity, message transport, central synchronization endpoint
getEdgeNodeHealth.route_specific_requirement: Report operational state separately from attestation or proof of integrity.
getEdgeNodeHealth.acceptance_gate: Offline policy, expiry, stale authority/rule checks, replay prevention, partitions, restart and rejoin are tested.

listCaseEvents.dependencies: Append-only event store, authorization and integrity metadata
listCaseEvents.route_specific_requirement: Paginate and authorize access to case-linked history.
listCaseEvents.acceptance_gate: Case-scoped access, completeness, integrity verification, retention and tamper-evidence tests pass.

getAuditEvent.dependencies: Append-only event store, authorization and integrity metadata
getAuditEvent.route_specific_requirement: Return event/integrity metadata without claiming truth of external assertions.
getAuditEvent.acceptance_gate: Case-scoped access, completeness, integrity verification, retention and tamper-evidence tests pass.

proposeGovernanceChange.dependencies: Versioned change registry, role separation, signing/approval mechanism
proposeGovernanceChange.route_specific_requirement: Record proposed versioned change and proposer identity.
proposeGovernanceChange.acceptance_gate: Separation of proposer/approver, quorum/policy checks, activation timing, rollback and immutable decision history are tested.

approveGovernanceChange.dependencies: Versioned change registry, role separation, signing/approval mechanism
approveGovernanceChange.route_specific_requirement: Require separate authorized approver and preserve immutable approval history.
approveGovernanceChange.acceptance_gate: Separation of proposer/approver, quorum/policy checks, activation timing, rollback and immutable decision history are tested.

global_gates: Every protected request has authenticated service/principal identity and operation-level authorization.
All mutating routes define idempotency, conflict handling, transaction boundary, durable audit record and retry semantics.
Every route validates contract version, request size, content type, schema and expected prior/rule version where relevant.
Unknown, deferred, rejected, simulated and final results remain distinguishable in API responses and logs.
Production routes have rate limits, timeouts, bounded retries, pagination where collections are returned, and correlation IDs.
Secrets, full credentials, raw identity documents and unrestricted sensitive payloads are excluded from generic logs and audit envelopes.
Every route has unit, contract, integration and relevant adversarial/failure-injection tests plus a named owner.
